clauses.source: RBI Master Direction on Fraud Risk Management in Commercial Banks (July 2024)
clauses.summary: An account showing early warning signals of fraud is red-flagged, which triggers deeper investigation and preventive measures.

clauses.source: RBI Master Direction on Fraud Risk Management in Commercial Banks (July 2024)
clauses.summary: Payment transactions should be monitored in real time, and banks should contain unauthorised or fraudulent transactions, with attention to money mule accounts.

clauses.source: RBI Master Direction on Fraud Risk Management in Commercial Banks (July 2024)
clauses.summary: An analytics unit should monitor digital payment patterns and initiate appropriate measures.

clauses.source: RBI Master Direction on Fraud Risk Management in Commercial Banks (July 2024)
clauses.summary: Before a person or entity is declared fraudulent, the bank must issue a show-cause notice with full details, allow a reply period of at least 21 days, examine the reply, and record a reasoned order.

clauses.source: RBI Master Direction on Fraud Risk Management in Commercial Banks (July 2024)
clauses.summary: Natural justice applies before the classification of an account as fraud.

clauses.source: RBI Master Direction on Fraud Risk Management in Commercial Banks (July 2024)
clauses.summary: Fraud incidents may need reporting to law enforcement agencies, depending on bank type and amount.

clauses.source: RBI Master Direction on Fraud Risk Management in Commercial Banks (July 2024)
clauses.summary: Disputed, suspected, or attempted payment-system fraud must be reported to RBI's payments fraud registry.

clauses.source: RBI Master Direction on Fraud Risk Management in Commercial Banks (July 2024)
clauses.summary: Fraud classified after the natural justice process is reported to RBI through the Fraud Monitoring Return within 14 days of classification.

clauses.source: RBI Master Direction on Fraud Risk Management in Commercial Banks (July 2024)
clauses.summary: Red-flagged credit accounts above a stated exposure threshold have reporting obligations to the credit information repository.
clauses.note: Paragraph number and threshold cited earlier from memory of the text. Confirm before use.

clauses.source: RBI Master Direction on Fraud Risk Management in Commercial Banks (July 2024)
clauses.summary: Red-flag status of a credit account is reported within a short window.
clauses.note: Window cited earlier as 7 days. Confirm before use.
